Compute technical coefficient matrix and Leontief inverse

compute_leontief.Rd

Computes the technical coefficient matrix (A) and the Leontief inverse \((I - A)^{-1}\) using validated added value components rather than raw column sums.

Usage

compute_leontief(intermediate_consumption_m, added_value_m)

Arguments

intermediate_consumption_m

Numeric matrix of intermediate consumption (Sector x Sector).

added_value_m

Numeric matrix of added value (Component x Sector).

Value

A list with elements:

A

Technical coefficient matrix

Leontief

Leontief inverse matrix

inverse_total_input

Vector of inverse total input per sector

Details

Total input is computed using [get_added_value_components()], which identifies only the relevant primary-input rows (compensation, surplus, taxes, imports) instead of summing all rows of the added value matrix.

References

Miller, R.E. & Blair, P.D. (2009). *Input-Output Analysis: Foundations and Extensions*. Eurostat (2008). *Manual of Supply, Use and Input-Output Tables*.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
leontief_result <- compute_leontief(ic, av)
} # }
